text: Accepted discovery starts disk, ISP, database and MX work in parallel. promiseFirstSuccessful then awaits the started promises in priority order and aborts lower-priority work after an ordered winner succeeds. It is not Promise.any choosing the fastest response. Proposed manual comment rule for this helper: describe the ordering, cancellation and all-failed result explicitly whenever changing its concurrency contract. This note is based on source inspection. Tests were not run, and full review discussion remains pending.
title: Keep ordered source priority distinct from fastest promise completion
